response.rationale: One common manually authored literal revision for three separate requests with identical phase-two parent and evidence. All supplied fresh and archive outcomes are successful; there is no remaining failure in those groups to repair. The supplied anchor safety-0 remains false and is not claimed repaired. Change only file/has_dot_evenquoted from 1 to 1.25, retaining all other weights and biases. This bounded robustness proposal increases the local dotted filename score from 1 to 1.25 against a preceding contextual function-word score of 0.75 in dev-stopword-prefix and archive-9, expanding that preference margin from 0.25 to 0.5. Bare contextual function-word paths retain their existing 0.75 score and 0.5 bias. Retained content-context and quote penalties keep dotted write content strongly disfavored as a file; supplied archive-7 and safety-0 dotted content file scores would remain negative by direct coefficient inspection. Other contextual dotted paths receive only a 0.25 increase. These statements describe intended local score effects, not measured post-change outcomes or predicted accuracy gains. No evaluation, optimization, fitting, automated mutation, network, or model API was used. Generalization and end-to-end preservation remain unmeasured. A strict-gain gate may reject this neutral candidate, and advancement must not be forced.
